title: Coastal halophyte plant Atriplex maximowicziana with previously undescribed terpenoids and anti-colorectal cancer chlorophyll stereoisomers utilizing a molecular networking approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45573-45588
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06325F, Paper
Open Access

Andrea Gu, Po-Jen Chen, Yih-Fung Chen, Ho-Cheng Wu, Tzong-Huei Lee
FBMN-guided isolation of Atriplex maximowicziana led to eight new and thirteen known compounds. Two new compounds showed anti-colorectal cancer activity.
